newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-GASCOIGNE RETAINED IN ENGLAND SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GASCOIGNE RETAINED IN ENGLAND SQUAD.

text.p: England manager Glenn Hoddle on Friday retained Rangers midfielder Paul Gascoigne in his squad to play Georgia in a World Cup qualifier despite calls for him to be dropped following allegations of wife-beating.
Hoddle included Gascoigne in a squad of 23 for the European group two match in Tbilisi on November 9.
Goalkeepers - David Seaman (Arsenal), Ian Walker (Tottenham Hotspur), David James (Liverpool)

Defenders - Gary Neville (Manchester United), Stuart Pearce (Nottingham Forest), Andy Hinchcliffe (Everton), Gareth Southgate (Aston Villa), Tony Adams (Arsenal), Sol Campbell (Tottenham Hotspur), Dominic Matteo (Liverpool)

Midfielders - Paul Ince (Inter Milan), Paul Gascoigne (Rangers), David Beckham (Manchester United), Steve McManaman (Liverpool), David Platt (Arsenal), David Batty (Newcastle), Matthew Le Tissier (Southampton)
Strikers - Nicky Barmby (Everton), Les Ferdinand (Newcastle), Teddy Sheringham (Tottenham), Robbie Fowler (Liverpool), Ian Wright (Arsenal), Paul Merson (Arsenal).
